supplements.title: Betanin-encapsulated nanoparticles mitigate neurotoxicity against AlCl3-induced Alzheimer's disease via modulation of AChE/TNF-α/IL-1β expression.
supplements.summary: Betanin-loaded nanoparticles improved cognitive function and reduced inflammation in an Alzheimer's disease rat model by mitigating oxidative stress and neuroinflammatory responses.

supplements.title: Bio-mediated synthesis of zinc oxide nanoparticles from Crossandra infundibuliformis leaves: A potent inducer of apoptosis in lung cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Biosynthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles from Crossandra infundibuliformis leaves effectively induce apoptosis in lung cancer cells by triggering oxidative stress and genetic changes.

supplements.title: Pan-cancer multi-omics characterization of CDK12 and virtual screening of Vietnamese natural products for novel inhibitors.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified CDK12 as a key cancer driver across multiple tumor types and discovered promising natural compound inhibitors from Vietnamese medicinal herbs.

supplements.title: Protective effect and results of glutamine and partially hydrolyzed Guar gum on rats with experimental radiation enteritis.
supplements.summary: Glutamine and partially hydrolyzed guar gum did not significantly protect rats from radiation-induced intestinal damage when administered during experimental radiation enteritis.

supplements.title: LC-MS/MS-based metabolomics analysis and experimental verification reveal the mechanism of Dahuang Mudan Decoction inhibition with the proliferation of colorectal cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Dahuang Mudan Decoction, a traditional herbal treatment, demonstrates potential to inhibit colorectal cancer cell growth by disrupting key metabolic pathways.

supplements.title: Naringenin Alleviates 5-Fluorouracil-Induced Intestinal Mucositis via Modulating the Gut Microbiota, Bile Acid Metabolism, and PPAR Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Naringenin reduces intestinal mucositis in chemotherapy by modifying gut bacteria, bile acids, and cellular pathways, potentially protecting patients from treatment-related digestive damage.

supplements.title: Withanolides from Physalis angulata as Potent Antimelanoma Agents: Activation of the p53 Pathway In Vitro and In Vivo.
supplements.summary: Specific withanolides from Physalis angulata effectively inhibit melanoma cell growth by activating the p53 pathway, demonstrating potential anti-cancer properties.

supplements.title: Diet, nutrition, and hormone therapy for prostate cancer: a systematic review with implications for future interventions.
supplements.summary: Given excellent prostate cancer outcomes, comorbidity management is critical to survivorship.

supplements.title: The Diet-Multiple Sclerosis Connection: Oxidative Stress and Emerging Mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Dietary interventions like Mediterranean and ketogenic diets may help reduce oxidative stress in multiple sclerosis by activating the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway.

supplements.title: Bone health in patients with cancer: a SEOM-SEIOMM consensus review of risk factors, assessment strategies, and management approaches.
supplements.summary: Comprehensive review highlights strategies to protect bone health in cancer patients by assessing risks and implementing targeted prevention and treatment approaches.

supplements.title: PINK1 deacetylation by emodin-induced SIRT3 upregulation alleviates acute kidney injury by Inhibition of ferroptosis.
supplements.summary: Emodin reduces acute kidney injury by activating SIRT3, which helps protect mitochondria and prevent cell death through PINK1 regulation.

supplements.title: Orthologue inference-based enzyme mining for diversification of the anti-cancer evodiamine scaffold.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered four enzymes from rare plants that can selectively modify evodiamine, an anti-cancer compound, potentially improving its therapeutic potential.

supplements.title: KDM6A alternative splicing induced by 25(OH)D inhibits breast cancer cell stemness through repressing TRAP1 transcription.
supplements.summary: 25(OH)D promotes an alternative KDM6A splice variant that reduces breast cancer cell stemness by suppressing TRAP1 transcription.

supplements.title: Vitamin D supplementation before in vitro fertilisation in women with polycystic ovary syndrome: multicentre, double blind, placebo controlled, randomised clinical trial.
supplements.summary: To evaluate whether vitamin D supplementation improves live birth rates in women with polycystic ovary syndrome undergoing in vitro fertilisation.

supplements.title: Dual-phytochemical electrospun PLA-PCL nanofibers loaded with centella asiatica extract and curcumin for sustained anticancer and antimicrobial drug delivery.
supplements.summary: Electrospun nanofibers combining Centella asiatica extract and curcumin demonstrate targeted, sustained anticancer activity against breast cancer cells with reduced toxicity.

off_label.title: Harnessing endophytes and Multi-Omics for sustainable Colchicine biosynthesis.
off_label.summary: Endophytic microorganisms in Gloriosa superba enhance colchicine production through metabolic interactions, offering a sustainable approach to biosynthesis for medical treatments.

off_label.title: Sacubitril/valsartan as a modulator of pulmonary fibrosis: insights into Lnc-SNHG-16/miR-455 modulation and Notch/Smad-3 pathway inhibition.
off_label.summary: Sacubitril/valsartan reduces pulmonary fibrosis by targeting specific molecular pathways, potentially decreasing inflammation and fibrotic tissue development in lung disease.

off_label.title: Leveraging Naturally Assembled Tumor Extracellular Vesicles as Self-Adjuvanting Nanovaccines to Potentiate Cancer Immunotherapy via cGAS/STING Activation.
off_label.summary: Researchers transformed tumor cell waste into a cancer vaccine by loading extracellular vesicles with nanoparticles, effectively activating immune responses and enabling tumor eradication.

off_label.title: Sleep patterns and the risk of psoriatic disease: genetic predisposition and metabonomics.
off_label.summary: Sleep disruption may increase genetic risk and metabolic changes associated with developing psoriatic disease.

off_label.title: Efficacy and safety of baricitinib versus azathioprine, both combined with topical corticosteroids, in patients with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis: a single-centre randomized open-label trial.
off_label.summary: Baricitinib was found to be as effective and safe as azathioprine when combined with topical steroids for treating moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.

off_label.title: Elucidating key targets and mechanisms of diethyl phthalate-induced colorectal cancer through network toxicology and molecular docking.
off_label.summary: Diethyl phthalate (DEP), a widely used plasticizer with endocrine-disrupting properties, has raised concerns regarding its potential carcinogenic effects.

off_label.title: A machine learning model for optimizing treatment of patients with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes.
off_label.summary: A machine learning model predicts the most effective diabetes medication by analyzing individual patient characteristics to guide personalized treatment selection.

off_label.title: Metal-Phenolic Networks-Based Nanozyme Reprograms Tumor Metabolism and Immunosuppressive Microenvironment to Enhance Ferroptosis and Potentiate Cancer Immunotherapy.
off_label.summary: A metal-phenolic nanozyme loaded with multiple compounds reprograms tumor metabolism, induces ferroptosis, and boosts immune response against cancer cells.

off_label.title: Pan-cancer immunogenomics and structure-guided repurposing identify N-Acetyl-L-carnosine as a PAR2 binding modulator.
off_label.summary: N-Acetyl-L-carnosine was identified as a potential PAR2-binding molecule in head and neck and lung cancers, offering a new approach to modulate tumor immune suppression.

off_label.title: Evocalcet improved the PTH-calcium setpoint and suppressed parathyroid proliferation in mice model of primary hyperparathyroidism.
off_label.summary: Evocalcet reduced parathyroid hormone levels and slowed cell growth in a mouse model of primary hyperparathyroidism by targeting the calcium-sensing receptor.

off_label.title: H2S-Activable BiFeO3-x Nanocatalysts for Ferroptosis-Driven Cancer Immunotherapy.
off_label.summary: H2S-activated BiFeO3-x nanoparticles trigger ferroptosis and immune response in colorectal cancer by generating reactive oxygen species and transforming the tumor microenvironment.

off_label.title: AKR1C inhibitors medroxyprogesterone acetate and mefenamic acid exhibit antitumor activity alone and combined with carboplatin in platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian cancer models.
off_label.summary: Medroxyprogesterone acetate and mefenamic acid show promise in treating platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian cancer by inhibiting tumor growth and migration.

off_label.title: The cyclin dependent kinase (CDK)7 inhibitor BS-181 inhibits pathogenic Cryptococcus species, causing G2/M arrest and a splicing defect.
off_label.summary: BS-181, a CDK7 inhibitor, effectively inhibits Cryptococcus growth and enhances antifungal drug performance by disrupting cell cycle progression and gene splicing.

off_label.title: Antithrombotic therapy for cancer-associated venous thromboembolism.
off_label.summary: Low-molecular-weight heparins and direct oral anticoagulants are effective first-line treatments for managing venous thromboembolism in cancer patients, with treatment selection based on individual risk factors.

off_label.title: Beyond Thiol-Enzyme Inhibition: Sterically Bulky NHC-Au(I) Complexes are Catalytically Active Anticancer Agents with Reprogrammed Immunomodulatory Function.
off_label.summary: A novel gold-based anticancer compound (Au-8) selectively kills cancer cells while preserving immune cell function through strategic molecular design.

biomarkers.title: AMPK-dependent maturation of hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes induced by human cardiac fibroblast exosomes.
biomarkers.summary: Human cardiac fibroblast exosomes enhance the maturity and regenerative potential of stem cell-derived heart cells through an AMPK-dependent mechanism.

biomarkers.title: DRP1 depletion protects NK cells from hypoxia-induced dysfunction.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking the DRP1 protein helps natural killer immune cells maintain their cancer-fighting ability in low-oxygen tumor environments.

biomarkers.title: Time to access matters: patient gains from faster CAR T-cell reimbursement in Europe.
biomarkers.summary: Despite clinical efficacy and cost-effectiveness, time to reimbursement for chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapies varies greatly across Europe.

biomarkers.title: Health and productivity benefits of anti-PD-(L)1 agents for early-stage cancer treatment in Hungary.
biomarkers.summary: In Hungary, early-stage cancer patients treated with anti-PD-(L)1 agents could experience significant health and productivity improvements compared to treating only metastatic cases.

biomarkers.title: Cost-effectiveness of the GAAD algorithm for hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance of patients with compensated cirrhosis: a model-based analysis using Italian real-world data.
biomarkers.summary: Early detection of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in patients with compensated cirrhosis (CC) is critical for improving prognosis.

biomarkers.title: HOTAIR promotes the progression of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia by regulating the miR-326/IGF-1R axis and activating the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: In B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, the HOTAIR gene promotes cancer progression by interacting with specific molecular pathways that enhance tumor growth.

biomarkers.title: Evaluating the Diagnostic Accuracy of Ultrasound-Guided Omental Biopsy in Relation to Pre-Biopsy Computed Tomography Imaging.
biomarkers.summary: Ultrasound-guided omental biopsy demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy (90.67%) with no complications in identifying omental involvement in cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: DoBSeqWF: a framework for sensitive detection of individual genetic variation in pooled sequencing data.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a computational workflow (DoBSeqWF) that enables sensitive and cost-effective detection of rare genetic variations in pooled sequencing data for potential early disease diagnosis.

biomarkers.title: Does Increased Echogenicity in the Caudothalamic Groove Always Indicate Hemorrhage in Early Infancy?
biomarkers.summary: In neonatal brain imaging, increased caudothalamic groove echogenicity does not always indicate hemorrhage, but may reflect various non-hemorrhagic brain changes.

biomarkers.title: A Novel Peptide, HS1002, Enhances Antitumor Activity via Dual Targeting of the GnRH Receptor and Human Telomerase Reverse Transcriptase in Prostate Cancer Cells.
biomarkers.summary: HS1002, a novel peptide targeting GnRH receptor and hTERT, effectively suppresses prostate cancer cell growth and enhances anticancer immune responses.

biomarkers.title: The Potential Association Between Latent Toxoplasma gondii Infection and Opioid Abuse: A Registry-Based Sero-Molecular Case-Control Study.
biomarkers.summary: In northern Iran, opioid abusers showed significantly higher rates of latent Toxoplasma gondii infection compared to healthy individuals.

biomarkers.title: Monitoring of plasma and urine tumor-derived DNA to inform bladder-sparing approaches for patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Monitoring tumor DNA in plasma and urine could help identify bladder cancer patients who can safely avoid bladder removal after initial treatment.

biomarkers.title: Oncogenic function and transcriptional dynamics of MYCN in liver tumorigenesis.
biomarkers.summary: In mice, MYCN overexpression combined with AKT activation promotes liver cancer development by creating a stress-adaptive, metastasis-prone cellular environment.

biomarkers.title: Disrupted energy metabolism is associated with retinal ganglion cell degeneration in autosomal dominant optic atrophy.
biomarkers.summary: In an autosomal dominant optic atrophy mouse model, disrupted energy metabolism in retinal ganglion cells leads to cell degeneration, with potential treatment through NAD+ redox ratio restoration.

biomarkers.title: MPC1 deficiency promotes melanoma progression via Wnt/β-catenin signaling.
biomarkers.summary: MPC1 deficiency promotes melanoma progression by activating the Wnt/β-catenin pathway, enhancing cancer cell growth and spread.

trials.summary: Human cardiac fibroblast exosomes enhance the maturity and regenerative potential of stem cell-derived heart cells through an AMPK-dependent mechanism.

trials.title: Cyclin D1 and the resistance landscape of HIF2 inhibition in clear-cell renal cell carcinoma: Insights from a mini-review.
trials.summary: In clear-cell renal cell carcinoma, Cyclin D1 contributes to HIF2 inhibitor resistance by driving cell proliferation and angiogenesis.

trials.title: Teclistamab plus Daratumumab in Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma.
trials.summary: Teclistamab combined with daratumumab effectively treated patients with heavily pretreated multiple myeloma, showing promising durable responses in clinical trials.
